.DISCUSSION...
KEY MESSAGE...Prolonged period of dry weather with increasingly
above normal temperatures this week.

High pressure will remain anchored over the central Appalachians
through most of this week. This high pressure should then move
northeast towards this weekend, reaching the Maritimes towards
Sunday. Abundant sunshine and a general westerly wind will
result in increasingly warmer conditions through at least
Friday. There could be a brief cooldown as this high pressure
passes directly overhead, but still thinking above normal
temperatures persist.

Not seeing much opportunity for precipitation this week. There
remain very large differences with the location of a potential
low pressure off the Eastern Seaboard early next week. Given the 
time range involved, will mention the possibility of some
rainfall Sunday into Monday. However, confidence in the details
remain low.
